modmenu.summaryTranslation.remote_intera: Control attached blocks remotely with 15 quick slots.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.remote_in:
Attach receivers to buttons, levers and doors without extra items, then control them remotely.

Includes 15 quick slots, automatic assignment for new receivers, custom key combinations, a movable and resizable quick window, and configurable receiver outlines.

Start with /ri or the configuration button. Shortcuts are unassigned by default.

Multiplayer requires the mod on both client and server. Remote targets must be in loaded chunks in the same dimension.

remote_interaction.help.1: 1. Open /ri, choose Attach receiver, then right-click a nearby block to attach or remove your existing receiver. The block does not activate. Esc cancels.
remote_interaction.help.2: 2. Set Menu, Attach and Quick shortcuts in the mod panel. All start unassigned. Combinations such as Shift + R are supported.
remote_interaction.help.3: 3. Quick slots opens the layout editor. Use each slot's Edit button to select receivers. Auto-add assigns new receivers to empty slots. Drag the window or corner, then save the layout.
remote_interaction.help.4: Hold the quick key to lock your view and release the cursor. Click a name/status area to activate its entire slot. Release the key to close.
remote_interaction.help.5: Supports buttons, levers, doors, trapdoors, gates, repeaters, comparators, note blocks, bells and daylight detectors. Excludes iron doors/trapdoors and containers.
remote_interaction.help.6: Only your receivers in loaded chunks in your current dimension can activate. Unavailable members are skipped. The game keeps running. Use the same mod version on the server.
